status: declared (unscored); committed before the engine predicts any wave-2 row
declared: 2026-10-22, Exam Proctor, after counting the population (row/paper counts only; no prediction, residual or label statistic looked at)
authority: context/decisions/SEALED_TEST_SET.md (Nik): score the current engine once on wave 2 for TTI, THR, avg HRR; pre-declare script, metric and population.
run_once: The script runs exactly once in scoring mode and refuses to run if experiments/results/wave2_exam_round1.json exists. No change to model, features, rows, metrics or baselines after the score is seen; any re-run needs a new config and is labelled as such.

model.what: the current engine, engine/dravix_engine.py on relaunch-v2: litcone primary blend (HGB + ExtraTrees + Ridge on log1p, v3 features, top-100 additive vocabulary, predictions clipped to the training range)
model.training_data: data/v2/cone_lit_benchmark_v1.csv, 4,529 rows / 806 papers, sha256 0b2af8e1817bdda1a9b1980e481b44d75ac62763f032696090aacd5545e05f99 (built by litcone_gt_round1 FINAL from 5,015 merged rows, before wave 2 landed). Script asserts the sha and the per-target training counts TTI 3368 / pHRR 4017 / THR 3355 / avg_HRR 759.
model.fit: E.train() into a temporary path (the repo's gitignored bundle is not used or overwritten); predictions via E.predict(rows), the same call the demo/server uses.

population.processing: train_litcone_gt_round1.load_rows() on the current tree (identical merge, figure-row exclusion, numeric parsing, DOI normalisation, paper-level source dedupe and (paper, formulation_label, flux, thickness) dedupe as the snapshot build), keep rows whose pmcid is a wave-2 pmcid, drop material_form in {textile, coated_substrate}.
population.leakage_rule: drop any row whose paper group, DOI or pmcid appears in the training snapshot, or whose (DOI, formulation_label) appears there.

per_target.rule: target > 0 and heat_flux_kWm2 non-blank (same as training)

targets.also_reported: pHRR (phrr_kWm2), reported separately: wave 2 is no longer sealed for pHRR (amendment 14 fits), but the engine itself never saw wave 2, so it is a valid held-out score for this engine only.

metrics.headline: R2 in raw units (s, kW/m2, MJ/m2), as in litcone_gt_round1
metrics.ci: 95% percentile CI by paper bootstrap: 2,000 resamples of papers with replacement (numpy default_rng seed 0), same resamples for every predictor; paired engine-minus-baseline R2 difference with CI on the same resamples

baselines.matrix_median: training-snapshot median of the target per matrix_canonical (rows in that target's training set); unseen matrix -> overall training median. Scored on every exam row.
baselines.neat_control: same wave-2 paper's is_control row, same target, same heat flux (thickness-matched if several), raw value. Scored on non-control rows that have one (control rows themselves excluded); engine and matrix_median re-scored on that same subset. Reported only if >= 10 rows and >= 5 papers. Note: uses the paper's own measured control, information the engine does not get.

comparison: engine's earlier unseen-paper scores on the training snapshot (litcone_gt_round1_FINAL.log, primary, P3 paper-grouped 5x10 mean): TTI -0.247, pHRR 0.286, THR 0.244, avg_HRR 0.234
reporting: experiments/results/wave2_exam_round1.json, experiments/runs/wave2_exam_round1.log and .md; one line appended to context/decisions/SEALED_TEST_SET.md. Nothing on the site; wording is Nik's call. Quote as 'held-out, collected after the model was built'. Never 'beats SOTA'; comparable stays a human decision.
never: no row dropped after seeing its residual
no second scoring run under this config
no edit to numbers_of_record.json, leaderboard or trackers
